findings.rationale: The mirror IS in the change set: `git diff --stat develop..HEAD -- platforms/codex/plugin` shows the regenerated mirror files in commits 6af4d2ea/a93ae744, `diff scripts/dispatch-hetero.sh platforms/codex/plugin/scripts/dispatch-hetero.sh` is empty, and `sync-codex-plugin-skills.sh --check` passes. The reviewer could not see it because this collect was run with `--exclude platforms/codex/plugin` to keep the reviewed diff at 57 KB instead of double — the exclusion is recorded in range.json. A blind spot of the review setup, not of the change.

Correct observation; the gate over-counts by the trailing newline(s) that $(cat) strips, so it only ever fails toward refusal. Trigger: an exact-bytes receipt requirement, which nothing asks for today.
